description: Measured electrical conductivity is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Czech Geological Survey for EuroGeoSurveys. Measured electrical conductivity of the groundwater at a defined depth interval or for a single point in depth. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include shallow geothermal energy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
